seo.title: Business Automation Software in Bangladesh
seo.description: A plain guide to business automation: which office work to automate, where to start and what it saves. Plus Spectrum's online forms, approval workflows and dashboards.

hero.title: Business *automation*
hero.lead: Which office tasks can run by themselves, where to start, and what it really saves. Then, how Spectrum turns paper-based work into fast digital workflows.

intro: A file that waits on a desk for a week. A form filled in by hand, then typed into a computer, then printed again. A report that takes two days to put together every month. Business automation means letting software do this kind of repetitive work, so people can spend their time on decisions instead of paperwork.

sections.title: Automation in simple terms
body: Automation is software that follows your rules for you. When a form is submitted, it checks it, sends it to the right person, reminds them if they forget, records the decision and tells the applicant. Nobody has to carry a file from desk to desk.
It does not replace people. It removes the waiting, copying and chasing that sit between the decisions people make.

sections.title: Where to start
sections.lead: The best first processes to automate have three things in common:

items.title: They happen often,
items.text: such as daily applications, requests or orders.

items.title: They follow clear rules,
items.text: so the steps can be written down.

items.title: They cause delays or complaints
items.text: today, so the benefit is easy to see.

after: Common signs you are ready: staff re-type the same information into several systems, files get lost, and nobody can say where a request is right now.

sections.title: Automation in Bangladesh
body: Online payment through Bangladesh Bank's e-challan, mobile financial services and electronic signatures, which the ICT Act 2006 recognises, make it possible to run many processes fully online, from application to payment to approval.
Government offices have moved licences, court cases and certificates online. Private companies are doing the same for purchasing, HR requests, customer onboarding and field reports.

items.title: Faster decisions.
items.text: Files no longer wait on desks.

items.title: Fewer mistakes.
items.text: Information is entered once and checked automatically.

items.title: Clear tracking.
items.text: Anyone can see where a request is.

items.title: A full record
items.text: of who did what, and when, for audits.

items.title: A bad process stays bad.
items.text: Fix the steps first, then automate them.

items.title: People need training
items.text: and time to get used to new tools.

items.title: Exceptions still need people.
items.text: Unusual cases should go to a person, not be forced through rules.

items.title: It needs looking after.
items.text: Rules change, and the system must change with them.

items.a: In most cases, no. It removes repetitive tasks such as copying data and chasing files, so staff can handle more work and focus on decisions and customers.

items.q: Can it work with the software we already use?
items.a: Usually yes. New workflows can connect to accounting software, ERP, payment gateways and SMS services, so information moves between them without re-typing.

items.q: Are electronic signatures legal in Bangladesh?
items.a: Yes. The ICT Act 2006 gives legal recognition to electronic signatures. Some documents have extra rules, so we check the requirements for each process.

items.q: How long does a first project take?
items.a: A single process, such as an approval workflow or an online application, can often go live in a few weeks. Larger systems are built in stages.

items.q: Can it read our old paper files?
items.a: Yes. Scanned papers can be read by AI that understands Bangla and English, so old records can be searched and used.

sections.text: Now that you know what automation can do, here is how *Spectrum* builds it.

sections.title: Less paper, *faster decisions*
body: Spectrum turns paper-based processes into online workflows: forms that check themselves, approvals that move on their own, documents signed electronically, and dashboards that show where everything is.
We have done this for licences and public complaints at national scale, and we bring the same approach to businesses and offices of any size.
